derivation.ageDays: whole days from the customer's latest earlier positive invoice to the cancellation invoice
derivation.key: sha256 of a fixed salt plus the cancellation invoice number, first 24 hex characters
derivation.priorRefunds: the customer's cancellation invoices strictly before this one
derivation.tier: enterprise when total positive spend is at or above the 0.8 customer quantile (2957.47)
derivation.total: that earlier positive invoice's quantity times price, rounded to cents

source.citation: Chen, D. (2019). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
